definitionZh: 卷轴-snap-型CSS属性设置在一个卷轴容器上,通过在卷轴端口内设定坐标点执行的方向和严格性,将其选择为滚动抓取.
sourceDefinition: The scroll-snap-type CSS property is set on a scroll container, opting it into scroll snapping by setting the direction and strictness of snap point enforcement within the snap port.
